blockingFindings.description: Direct review of V212 sit and crouch shows the inner layer covering both thighs nearly to the knees, but the outer lilac apron hem still leaves the center of the lap uncovered and forms sharp points beside and between the knees. Reshape the authored front panels so one continuous edged lap spans the flexed thighs.

V212 left and right profiles show the extended apron projecting well ahead of the knees. The prone view folds it back beneath the hips into a long flap with overlapping creases. Reduce forward projection and control the panel transition while keeping clearance and hem continuity.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
